title: Amazon Manager
description:
Apply using this link:  



Who We Are

Sunbelt Products is a small but successful and growing eCommerce company based in Odessa, FL that has been in business for more than 15 years.  In 2011 we started in a modest 600 square foot warehouse and over the years have progressively grown into a 25,000 square foot operation.  

We sell our own branded products (Liquid Stands, Pink Power, Sleepavo, HTM Lighting) that are manufactured to our specifications and listed on various channels such as Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Reverb, Target, and our own websites.  We fulfill orders in our warehouse and we prepare for and ship products to Amazon and Walmart warehouses for them to fulfill.  



Why Join Us

Ready for a change?  You will be joining a small but highly dynamic, dedicated, and motivated team.   We value continuous improvement and are readily open to new ideas and suggestions.  Each individual can and does make a difference!  



About the Position

Sunbelt Products is seeking a dedicated Amazon Manager  to join our growing team. This role will lead the engagement and the day-to-day business strategy for Amazon. 

The Amazon Channel Manager will create and implement strategic growth plans in collaboration with the whole Channel Management Team. He/She will also be responsible for sustaining and continuous development of the company’s Amazon account. 

The ideal candidate must be highly motivated and an expert in all aspects of Amazon. You’ll be an integral part of the Channel Management Team in assisting on the expansion of our brands and excellent sales.





This position is fully remote and follows a Monday through Friday work schedule with weekends off.



What You Will Do

Hire, mentor, develop and coach all direct reports.

Drive the achievement of agreed internal and external KPIs and standards. 

Ensure all SOPs are maintained properly, well-organized, and implemented.

Enhance, optimize, and execute sales and marketing strategies for Amazon marketplace's growth and achievement of KPI's .

Own all Amazon related processes.  

Keep up to date with new features and trends.  

Create, streamline and manage reports to achieve success

Manage FBA inventory levels to prevent out of stocks while also avoiding unnecessary storage fees.

Work and strategize with internal teams on Amazon advertising initiatives to boost revenue and enhance brand growth.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree

Minimum of 2 years Amazon Seller Central experience.

Proficient with Excel/Google Sheets.

Gathering and analyzing data.

Strong problem solving skills

Excellent command of the English language.





Desired Qualifications

Experienced with Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and other e-commerce marketplaces.

Experienced with DataRova, Data Dive, Scale Insights, Sellerise, Helium 10, and other Amazon analytics and optimization tools.

Knowledgeable in using AI tools to improve reporting, data analysis, process automation, content creation, keyword research, and operational efficiency.

Proficient in leveraging AI to generate actionable insights, identify trends, summarize performance data, and support data-driven decision-making.





Pay & Benefits

Competitive Salary 

Profit Sharing

Bonus / 13th month pay

HMO

Paid National Holidays

Vacation / Service Incentive Leave

Birthday Leave with Pay

Parents’ Leave

title: Remote Accounting Coordinator (Work from Home)
description:
Remote Accounting Coordinator (Work from Home)

CAD $9 to $10 per hour | 9-hour shifts | Eastern Time zone coverage

Independet Contractor



A growing North American facilities services organization is expanding its remote accounting support and is seeking dependable, detail-oriented professionals. This is a work-from-home independent contractor engagement supporting commercial and retail clients across Canada.



The role is paid weekly upon receipt of invoice. The schedule is 9-hour shifts, five (5) days per week. Occasional Saturday shifts (approximately once per month) may be required. Shifts align with Eastern Standard Time: 8:00–5:00, 9:00–6:00, or 10:00–7:00 EST.



Role Overview

This is a fast-moving, highly collaborative accounting support engagement within a structured, system-driven environment. Work is coordinated in real time via Zoom and internal platforms to ensure financial accuracy and maintain workflow efficiency.



As part of the accounting support function, you will work closely with internal teams, vendors, and clients, as well as play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting billing processes, and ensuring smooth daily operations. 



What You’ll Do

Customer Invoicing: Generate invoices, track deposits, process purchase order invoicing, support job costing, and assist with new client setup.

Accounts Receivable & Payable Support: Post daily cash receipts, support accounts payable data entry, assist with credit card reconciliations, and coordinate vendor payments.

Collections & Follow-Up: Monitor aging reports, follow up on outstanding receivables, issue delinquency notices, and assist in resolving invoice disputes professionally and efficiently.

Financial Reporting Support: Prepare ad-hoc management reports, create financial schedules as needed, and assist with month-end close tasks.

Documentation & Compliance: Review supporting documentation, such as work orders, approvals, and sign-offs, to ensure billing accuracy and audit readiness.

Vendor & Client Communication: Serve as a professional liaison between internal teams, vendors, and customers to resolve discrepancies and maintain positive relationships.

Process Improvement: Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend improvements to strengthen accounting operations.



Requirements for Home Office Set-Up

• Preferred: Windows PC running Windows 11.

• Minimum 300 Mbps internet speed (600 Mbps preferred); fibre connection strongly preferred.

• Multiple monitors required (single monitor setups are not suitable).

• High-quality headset with microphone.

• Reliable webcam.

• Quiet, professional workspace suitable for full-day Zoom collaboration.



What You Bring

Accounting Experience: Previous experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, or bookkeeping support is required. Experience working in remote or virtual accounting environments preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Comfortable working across multiple systems, databases, and accounting platforms simultaneously.

Organization: You can handle high
 volumes, prioritize tasks, and keep everything on track.

Problem-solving: You take initiative, think independently, and easily resolve issues.

Collaborative Communicator: You work confidently with others, fostering accountability and motivation. You are a positive, self-motivated individual with clear communication.

Composed Under Pressure: You enjoy working within tight deadlines with close attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation

$5–$7: Simple talking-head reels with captions, light B-roll, and basic edits

$8–$10: Standard creative reels with stronger B-roll, text effects, visual changes, pacing, and storytelling

Up to $15: More involved reels requiring additional creative work, research, motion elements, or more detailed editing

title: Local SEO & AI Search Specialist for Rank-and-Rent Websites | GHL Experience Required
description:
JOB OVERVIEW:



I am building a portfolio of local lead generation websites targeting service businesses in multiple US markets.



This business model is commonly called “rank and rent.” Each website will target a specific service and geographic area, rank organically, generate phone calls and form submissions, and provide those leads to qualified local businesses.



The websites do not have to be built or hosted in GHL. They may be built using WordPress, GHL, or another platform when there is a clear SEO, performance, or scalability advantage.



GHL will be our central CRM. Website forms, chat, call tracking, pipelines, lead notifications, follow-up automations, lead delivery, and reporting should be connected to GHL.



I am looking for someone who can help research, build, rank, integrate, and manage these websites. This will begin as a part-time or project-based position with the opportunity to become a long-term, full-time role as the portfolio grows.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Research US service niches and geographic markets with valuable demand and manageable competition

• Recommend the best website platform and explain the recommendation in plain English

• Build fast, professional, mobile-friendly lead-generation websites

• Create service pages, location pages, and useful supporting content

• Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, technical SEO, and on-page SEO

• Implement appropriate local business, service, FAQ, breadcrumb, and other schema

• Optimize websites for Google, Bing, voice search, and AI-powered search platforms

• Build ethical citations, backlinks, local relevance, and topical authority

• Connect external websites to GHL

• Configure GHL forms, chat, calendars, phone numbers, call tracking, pipelines, and workflows

• Automate lead notifications, follow-up, routing, and delivery to local businesses

• Track rankings, traffic, calls, form submissions, and lead performance

• Provide clear weekly progress reports



The ideal applicant will also be willing to help identify and contact local business owners who may want to purchase the generated leads. Cold
, appointment setting, outreach, or lead sales experience is preferred but not required.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



• Fluent written and spoken English

• Proven local SEO experience, in US markets

• Experience building local service or lead-generation websites

• Hands-on GHL CRM and automation experience

• Experience integrating externally hosted websites with GHL

• Knowledge of Local SEO, AEO, GEO, AI search optimization, and schema

• Ability to research keywords, competitors, service niches, and geographic markets

• Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and Bing Webmaster Tools

• Ability to communicate technical recommendations in plain English

• Reliable, organized, and able to work independently



Rank-and-rent experience is preferred, but applicants with strong local SEO, website development, and GHL integration experience are encouraged to apply.



IMPORTANT



I want ethical and sustainable SEO. Do not apply if your strategy depends on fake Google Business Profiles, fake addresses, fake reviews, copied content, spam backlinks, misleading schema, or guaranteed rankings.



Some websites may not qualify for a Google Business Profile. You should understand how to rank websites organically without depending on a GBP and how to work with an eligible local business’s profile when appropriate.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please include:



1. A link to a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining your experience with local SEO, websites, and GHL.

2. Two examples of local websites you personally built, optimized, or helped rank. Briefly explain your role and the results.

3. A short explanation of how you would identify a promising US service niche and geographic market.

4. The website platforms you recommend for rank-and-rent websites and why.

5. A description of your GHL experience, including external website integrations, forms, call tracking, pipelines, workflows, automations, and reporting.

6. A brief explanation of how you optimize websites for both traditional search engines and AI-generated search results.

7. Any experience with business outreach, cold
, appointment setting, or selling leads.

8. Your desired hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a small paid trial project.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY & Growth

The right person can grow into a full-time position with the opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for building and managing a portfolio of local lead-generation websites.



The long-term role may include researching new markets, launching websites, improving rankings, managing GHL lead workflows, monitoring lead quality, connecting leads with local businesses, and helping create repeatable systems for expanding the portfolio.



I am looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship who can help build a real portfolio of income-producing digital assets.

Responsibilities

s, and LinkedIn

ntum. Some days that means making a large volume of calls. Other days it means chasing up warm prospects, refining a list, or finding the right contact inside a company that looked cold at first.

 outreach and LinkedIn prospecting

title: Developer — Kit (ConvertKit) API Integration & Automated Location-Based Email Service
description:
About Us




 is the leading online destination for Native American powwow culture, running on WordPress with an event calendar that receives over 125,000 visitors per month. We send

The Project



We want to build a custom service that automatically sends our subscribers a weekly

Here's how it needs to work:





Pull event data from WordPress. Our events live in an event calendar plugin on our WordPress site. The service needs to pull upcoming events (via the plugin's API/REST endpoints or database) including dates, locations, and event details.

Let subscribers choose their locations. Each subscriber should be able to select which U.S. states they want to see events from — and update those selections at any time. This preference data will be stored in Kit (custom fields and/or tags via the Kit API).

Generate personalized weekly
s. Every week, the service automatically generates and sends each subscriber an
 containing only the upcoming events in their selected states, delivered through our Kit account via the Kit API (v4).

Run reliably without manual work. Once built, the weekly
s should go out on schedule with no hands-on effort from us.





Scope of Work





Design and build a web service that connects our WordPress event calendar to our Kit account

Build the subscriber-facing location preference interface (initial selection + ability to update later)

Implement the Kit API integration: managing subscriber custom fields/tags, and creating/sending the weekly broadcast
s

Build the
 generation logic: filter events by state, format them into a clean
 template, handle subscribers whose states have no events that week

Set up scheduling/automation for the weekly send

Provide documentation and a reasonable handoff so we can maintain or extend the system

Advise on the best architecture — we're open to your recommendations on hosting, stack, and approach





Required Skills & Experience





REST API integration — this is the heart of the project. Must show prior work integrating third-party APIs. Direct experience with the Kit (ConvertKit) API is a big plus but not required if you have strong general API experience

WordPress development — comfortable working with WordPress plugins, the WP REST API, and/or querying WordPress data. Experience with event calendar plugins (e.g., The Events Calendar, Modern Events Calendar) is a plus

Backend/web service development — PHP, Python, or Node.js; building and deploying a hosted service with scheduled jobs (cron)

HTML
 — generating dynamic
 content that renders well across
 clients

Front-end basics — building a simple, clean preference-selection form for subscribers





Nice to Have





Experience with
 marketing platforms and their APIs (Kit/ConvertKit, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, etc.)

Experience with Liquid templating (Kit uses Liquid for dynamic
 content)

Experience building subscriber preference centers

Familiarity with webhooks for syncing data between systems





How to Apply



Please begin your application with the word "CALENDAR" in the first line. Then include:





A short introduction

Links or descriptions of 2–3 relevant projects — especially anything involving API integrations, WordPress, or
 automation

title: SEO Specialist
description:
**Sign-On Bonus**

We are happy to offer a $150 US sign-on bonus! The first $50 will come at the end of your first week of work. The additional $100 will come upon completion of 90 days of work for a full $150 bonus.





ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking a driven and strategic SEO Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing SEO strategies that improve search visibility, drive qualified traffic, and generate measurable results for our clients.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in local, organic, technical, and AI-assisted SEO. You should be comfortable managing multiple websites and campaigns simultaneously while translating data, research, structured data, and AI insights into effective, scalable SEO solutions. This position plays a key role in elevating client growth and supporting long-term SEO performance across a diverse portfolio.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The perfect candidate has 

*3 years of proven SEO experience, with a demonstrated record of driving measurable growth

*Strong experience in local and organic SEO, including strategy development and execution

*Hands-on experience with AI-driven SEO workflows, including AI-assisted research, content optimization, and adapting strategies for AI-influenced search results

*Working knowledge of schema markup and structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ, Review, Organization, etc.) and how it impacts visibility and CTR

*Advanced skills in SEO research, including keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor research, and opportunity mapping

*Proficiency in WordPress, particularly Elementor, and managing multiple websites at scale

*Strong understanding of technical SEO principles, including site structure, indexing, crawlability, and page performance

*Familiarity with SEO tools such as Analytics, SEMRush, Ubersuggest, Ahrefs, MOZ Local, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console

*A self-starter mindset balanced with strong collaboration and team contribution

*Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to QA work before delivery is a MUST



Not required, but strongly valued:

*Experience working in a high-volume SEO agency environment, managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

*Ability to adapt strategies to different industries, with an emphasis on local SEO for service-based businesses

*Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify growth opportunities

*Clear, confident communication skills; able to explain complex SEO concepts to both internal teams and clients

*Strong time management and time-blocking skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Conduct in-depth keyword, intent, and competitive research to identify SEO opportunities for both organic and local search

Develop and implement advanced SEO strategies, including on-page, off-page, technical, and AI-supported initiatives

Perform technical SEO audits and execute recommendations (site speed, indexing, URL structure, schema, internal linking)

Implement and maintain schema markup and structured data to improve search visibility and rich results

Optimize Google Business Profiles (GBP) to enhance local SEO performance and engagement

Perform competitor analysis to stay ahead of industry trends and algorithm changes

Collaborate with writers to produce SEO-first, conversion-focused content aligned with client goals

Manage WordPress websites using Elementor, including content publishing, on-page optimization, and redirects

Utilize tools such as RankMath, WP Rocket, and other SEO plugins to improve performance and compliance

Execute ethical link-building and citation-building strategies, including backlink audits and disavows when needed

Support site migrations and content transitions from old to new websites

Analyze performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, MOZ Local, SEMRush, Ubersuggest, and Ahrefs to guide ongoing optimization

Create clear, actionable reports that communicate insights and results to CSMs and clients

Develop and manage GBP posts, business descriptions, and product listings, leveraging AI tools (including ChatGPT) for personalization and efficiency

Stay current on SEO, AI search trends, and algorithm updates to keep strategies competitive and future-ready





MORE INFO, BENEFITS + PERKS:

1. This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2. 13th Month Pay

3. Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

4. Eight (8) Paid Holiday Leaves (Filipino Holidays)

5. Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (we plan to continue offering this as long as it is feasible)

An extraordinary team/company culture

title: Property Management Team Leader
description:
Job Summary:



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Remote Property Manager to lead the Shared Services Team. The ideal candidate has real short-term rental (STR) property management experience and is comfortable making fast, sound decisions on guest issues, policy exceptions, and revenue matters. The Remote Property Manager acts as the first line of leadership for the Shared Services Team, ensuring guests are taken care of, partners are informed, and revenue is distributed accurately and on time.



Key Responsibilities:



Team Leadership & Knowledge Management:



Lead the Shared Services Team in answering questions related to guest messages.

Ensure all guest and partner messages are sent according to the knowledge center protocol.

Keep the knowledge center updated with new information as procedures and policies evolve.

Report inconsistencies to the Shared Services Team Leads and correct incorrect procedures.



Guest & Reservation Operations:



Monitor reservations and abnormalities related to in-house guest issues, resolving them directly whenever possible without the need to involve the partner.

Serve as the decision-maker for exceptions to policies and goodwill gestures.

Monitor the Slack channel and Hospitable 24/7, or ensure someone is correctly responding to escalations around the clock — including overnight hours, weekends, and holidays.

Manage housekeeping schedules and ensure tasks are handled correctly and on time.



Platform & Systems Oversight:



Communicate directly with OTA platforms and Hospitable when needed, escalating and finding alternative solutions when they are unhelpful or unresponsive.

Check that all automations are running correctly, and manually verify and correct workflows when they are not.

Revenue Management



Ensure that OTA Revenue is distributed to each partner accordingly.

Prepare owner statements and send all revenue to the partners every month



Requirements:



-Minimum of 3 years of experience in the short-term rental (STR) industry — hands-on, guest-facing property management experience is required, not adjacent hospitality or general customer service experience.

-Demonstrated working knowledge of the types of issues guests typically raise during a stay (check-in/check-out, access, amenities, cleanliness, noise, damage, cancellations, refunds, etc.) and how to resolve them appropriately

-Availability and willingness to work a non-traditional schedule, including being reachable for emergencies overnight, on weekends, and on holidays.



Additional Requirements:



-Prior experience managing or leading a team, ideally in a remote or distributed setting.

-Strong, confident decision-making skills, particularly around policy exceptions and guest goodwill gestures, balancing guest satisfaction with business impact.

-Working familiarity with major OTA platforms (Airbnb, 
, Vrbo/Expedia) and channel/property management systems such as Hospitable (or similar PMS tools).

-Comfort working within Slack and other messaging/escalation tools for round-the-clock monitoring.

-Basic financial literacy sufficient to review revenue distributions, reconcile payouts, and prepare monthly owner statements accurately.

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with guests, partners, and OTA support teams.

-Strong organizational skills to manage housekeeping schedules and coordinate across multiple moving parts simultaneously.

-Ability to identify process gaps or breakdowns (e.g., automation failures, outdated procedures) and take ownership of fixing them rather than just flagging them.

-Comfortable presenting updates and suggestions in meetings with cross-functional

-Reliable high-speed internet connection, a dedicated remote workspace, and a backup power/internet plan given the on-call nature of the role.

-High degree of integrity and transparency, given direct responsibility for partner revenue and owner reporting.



What Makes This Role a Good Fit:



This position suits an experienced STR property manager who thinks like an owner — someone who already knows how to keep guests happy, knows what "normal" looks like in day-to-day operations, and can be trusted to make judgment. It is best suited to someone who wants ownership over a portfolio's operational success rather than a narrowly-scoped, shift-only support role.



Work Schedule:



The successful candidate will work a minimum of 5 shifts of 8 hours per week and must be willing and able to step in outside of scheduled hours whenever operational emergencies arise — including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates who are not comfortable engaging with operations outside of standard business hours will not be a fit for this position.

title: Real Estate Walkthrough Reel Editor — DaVinci Resolve
description:
I’m looking for a video editor who works in DaVinci Resolve 20 to help create 30–60 second real estate walkthrough reels on a per-job basis.



These are primarily one-take walkthrough edits, not multi-clip edits. The goal is to take a single walkthrough clip and make it feel smooth, refined, polished, and natural.



This is not a flashy edit with heavy transitions. There should be no transitions unless specifically requested. The focus is on clean pacing, smooth motion, proper stabilization, straight verticals, tasteful speed ramping, and a bright, natural real estate look.



I will provide the footage along with specific instructions for each property. I will also provide color nodes, plugins, and tutorials to help match my editing style and workflow.



Responsibilities include:



Editing 30–60 second real estate walkthrough reels

Working fully in DaVinci Resolve

Following detailed instructions for each job

Editing primarily one-take walkthrough clips

Creating smooth, natural pacing

Applying subtle speed adjustments and ramping

Stabilizing footage where appropriate

Straightening verticals and correcting any distracting tilt

Applying provided color nodes/plugins

Making interiors feel bright, clean, and natural

Exporting final videos in the requested format



Ideal fit:



Someone who has experience with real estate, interior, architecture, or lifestyle video edits and understands how to make a walkthrough feel elegant and professional without over-editing it.



This would be paid per hour with a 24hr turnaround time. With experience, edits can take less than 30 minutes to complete.

title: Remote Legal Assistant / Intake Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We are a growing law firm looking for a Remote Legal Assistant / Intake Coordinator to support the administrative and operational side of our practice. This role handles client intake, case file organization, and day-to-day communication so our attorneys can focus on legal work rather than administrative tasks.



This is an early-stage type of hire in the sense that you will work closely with firm leadership and play a real role in keeping cases moving and clients informed.



This role works US business hours, which fall during the night in the Philippines. Please only apply if you are able to work a consistent night shift long term.



Core Responsibilities



Client Intake: Serve as an early point of contact for prospective clients. Gather case information, schedule consultations, and guide potential clients through the intake process.



Case File Organization: Maintain organized, accurate case files and documentation. Track deadlines and case status so nothing is missed.



Client Communication: Provide regular updates to clients on case progress. Handle routine questions professionally and know when to escalate to an attorney.



Document Support: Assist with preparing and organizing non-legal documentation, correspondence, and case materials. This role does not perform legal work or give legal advice.



Calendar and Deadline Tracking: Keep attorney calendars organized and flag upcoming deadlines, hearings, or filing dates well in advance.



What We Are Looking For



Required:



1 or more years of experience in an administrative, intake, customer service, or client coordination role (legal setting preferred but not required)

Comfortable learning a new case management system quickly (we will train on our specific platform)

Strong written and spoken English

Comfortable working independently in a remote environment on a night shift schedule

Organized with strong attention to detail



Preferred:



Direct experience with a case management system such as Clio, MyCase, or Filevine

Experience specifically in immigration, personal injury, family law, or another relevant practice area

Familiarity with legal document formatting and terminology

Previous experience working a night shift or graveyard schedule for a US-based company



Soft Skills We Care About:



Trustworthy with confidential and sensitive client information

Calm and reassuring with clients who may be going through a stressful legal situation

Proactive and organized, this role requires tracking many moving pieces at once

Clear communicator who knows the difference between administrative support and legal advice



Compensation and Details



Full time, 40 hours per week

Remote from the Philippines

Night shift hours aligned to US business hours

Pay range: $6 to $8 per hour depending on experience

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Care Property Hub is a growing UK property matchmaking platform that connects care providers with suitable properties. We run monthly networking events and regular virtual sessions, bringing together landlords, care operators, and property professionals. We’re building a community, and we need someone who can take ownership of making sure our social media content hits the mark, every time, on time.



About the Role

This is not a “just schedule some posts” role. You will be the person who makes sure our entire content operation runs smoothly. The founder writes the content and sets the direction, your job is to make sure it gets published correctly, on time, and to the standard our audience expects. You’ll coordinate between tea
mbers, chase deadlines, and be the quality gatekeeper for everything that goes out under the CPH brand.



You’ll also work with Opus Clip and recorded meeting footage to create short-form video clips, coordinating with our video producer (Soban) to turn raw recordings into polished social content. The person scheduling posts will report to you, you’re responsible for making sure everything is posted, not doing all the posting yourself.

LinkedIn is our primary channel, but you’ll also coordinate content across other platforms as we expand.



What You’ll Do

• Quality-control all content before it goes live — copy, images, links in comments, hashtags, tagging. If it’s not right, it doesn’t go out.

• Chase and manage the scheduler — the person posting content reports to you. You confirm everything is scheduled, published on time, and correct. “Has it been posted?” is your daily question.

• Work with Opus Clip to produce short-form video clips from recorded meetings and events. You’ll create initial cuts and pass them to Soban (our video producer) for final production, then ensure the finished videos are scheduled and posted.

• Coordinate the content pipeline — the founder writes the content and gives you direction. You make sure it moves through the chain (writing ? video production ? scheduling ? posting) without delays or errors.

• Report weekly on what’s been posted, what’s scheduled, what’s late, and what’s missing. No surprises.

• Propose creative ideas to grow our social media presence — especially video content. We have raw material and a growing community. We need someone who can see what’s working in the UK market and suggest what we should be doing next.



WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GO

This starts at 3 hours per week, but it won’t stay there if you’re the right person. We reward initiative with more responsibility, more hours, and more earning potential.

• Video strategy — we have meeting recordings, event footage, and founder content that could become a full video programme. If you can design and lead that, this role grows fast.

• Campaign strategy — help us sell more event tickets and attract more property listings to the platform. Prove you can drive results and the budget follows.

• Community growth — we’re not just posting content; we’re building a community in the UK care property sector. If you can grow that community, you become indispensable.

• Full Social Media Manager — for the right person, this grows into owning the entire social media and content function for CPH.



What We’re Looking For

• UK market knowledge — you know what’s working on social media in the UK right now, not just globally. You understand the UK audience, trends, and content formats that are actually getting results.

• Organised and relentless on deadlines — content schedules don’t manage themselves. You chase, you follow up, you don’t let things slip.

• Comfortable with video tools — experience with Opus Clip, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. You don’t need to be a professional editor, but you need to be able to produce clips from raw footage.

• Creative and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do. You research what’s working, propose ideas, and come to us with a plan. If you can pitch a new content project, we want to hear it.

• Comfortable with LinkedIn — you understand how professional B2B content works on LinkedIn, not just personal posting.

• Strong attention to detail — links in comments, correct hashtags, right images, no typos. Every post is checked before it goes out.

• Confident communicator — you’ll be coordinating between the founder, a video producer, and a scheduler. You need to be clear, direct, and not afraid to chase people.



Pay & Trial Period

Base salary + commission based on results. The more value you bring, the more you earn. We measure results, engagement growth, content consistency, video output, community growth, and your commission reflects what you deliver.

4-week paid trial. The first four weeks are a paid trial period. If you deliver what’s expected and show you can add value, this becomes an ongoing role with room to grow. If it’s not working, we’ll part ways, no hard feelings.

Only apply if you genuinely know what you’re doing and can add value to the team. We’re a small, bootstrapped business, and every person matters. If you’re looking for a role where you can coast, this isn’t it.



What Success Looks Like in Your First 4 Weeks

• Week 1: Understand the full content pipeline — who writes, who produces video, who schedules. Meet the team. Review all current social channels and content.

• Week 2: Take over QA and scheduling coordination. Every post is checked before publishing. Opus Clip workflow started with Soban.

• Week 3: All content going out on time with zero errors. Weekly reporting in place. At least one Opus Clip video has been published.

• Week 4: Propose one creative content idea or campaign based on what you’ve seen working in the UK market. Prove you’re not just coordinating; you’re thinking.



The Practicalities

• Hours: 3 hours per week to start — flexible on when those hours fall. Scope to grow significantly.

• Location: Fully remote — UK-based or UK timezone required.

• Contract: Freelance/contract basis.

• Pay: Base salary + performance commission. Discussed during application.

• Tools: We’ll provide access to everything you need (Opus Clip, scheduling platform, content calendar, brand assets).

• Trial: 4-week paid trial period.



About Care Property Hub

CPH is a UK-based property matchmaking platform purpose-built for the care sector. We connect care providers who need properties with landlords and developers who have them. Our monthly networking events and regular virtual sessions have become a go-to meeting point for the sector, and our LinkedIn presence is growing fast.

We’re a small, bootstrapped team that moves quickly and values people who take ownership. If you want to be part of building something from the ground up and actually see the impact of your work, this is that kind of role.



How to Apply

We don’t want a CV. We want to see effort.

Fill out our short application questionnaire:
. 

It takes about 20 minutes and includes a 60-second video introduction. 



If you can’t be bothered to complete it properly, this role isn’t for you.

title: SEO Specialist **See Sign-on Bonus!**
description:
**Sign-On Bonus**

We are happy to offer a $150 US sign-on bonus! The first $50 will come at the end of your first week of work. The additional $100 will come upon completion of 90 days of work for a full $150 bonus.





ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking a driven and strategic SEO Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing SEO strategies that improve search visibility, drive qualified traffic, and generate measurable results for our clients.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in local, organic, technical, and AI-assisted SEO. You should be comfortable managing multiple websites and campaigns simultaneously while translating data, research, structured data, and AI insights into effective, scalable SEO solutions. This position plays a key role in elevating client growth and supporting long-term SEO performance across a diverse portfolio.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The perfect candidate has 

*3 years of proven SEO experience, with a demonstrated record of driving measurable growth

*Strong experience in local and organic SEO, including strategy development and execution

*Hands-on experience with AI-driven SEO workflows, including AI-assisted research, content optimization, and adapting strategies for AI-influenced search results

*Working knowledge of schema markup and structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQ, Review, Organization, etc.) and how it impacts visibility and CTR

*Advanced skills in SEO research, including keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor research, and opportunity mapping

*Proficiency in WordPress, particularly Elementor, and managing multiple websites at scale

*Strong understanding of technical SEO principles, including site structure, indexing, crawlability, and page performance

*Familiarity with SEO tools such as Analytics, SEMRush, Ubersuggest, Ahrefs, MOZ Local, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console

*A self-starter mindset balanced with strong collaboration and team contribution

*Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to QA work before delivery is a MUST



Not required, but strongly valued:

*Experience working in a high-volume SEO agency environment, managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

*Ability to adapt strategies to different industries, with an emphasis on local SEO for service-based businesses

*Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to proactively identify growth opportunities

*Clear, confident communication skills; able to explain complex SEO concepts to both internal teams and clients

*Strong time management and time-blocking skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Conduct in-depth keyword, intent, and competitive research to identify SEO opportunities for both organic and local search

Develop and implement advanced SEO strategies, including on-page, off-page, technical, and AI-supported initiatives

Perform technical SEO audits and execute recommendations (site speed, indexing, URL structure, schema, internal linking)

Implement and maintain schema markup and structured data to improve search visibility and rich results

Optimize Google Business Profiles (GBP) to enhance local SEO performance and engagement

Perform competitor analysis to stay ahead of industry trends and algorithm changes

Collaborate with writers to produce SEO-first, conversion-focused content aligned with client goals

Manage WordPress websites using Elementor, including content publishing, on-page optimization, and redirects

Utilize tools such as RankMath, WP Rocket, and other SEO plugins to improve performance and compliance

Execute ethical link-building and citation-building strategies, including backlink audits and disavows when needed

Support site migrations and content transitions from old to new websites

Analyze performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, MOZ Local, SEMRush, Ubersuggest, and Ahrefs to guide ongoing optimization

Create clear, actionable reports that communicate insights and results to CSMs and clients

Develop and manage GBP posts, business descriptions, and product listings, leveraging AI tools (including ChatGPT) for personalization and efficiency

Stay current on SEO, AI search trends, and algorithm updates to keep strategies competitive and future-ready





MORE INFO, BENEFITS + PERKS:

1. This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2. 13th Month Pay

3. Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

4. Eight (8) Paid Holiday Leaves (Filipino Holidays)

5. Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (we plan to continue offering this as long as it is feasible)

An extraordinary team/company culture





APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

1. Use this subject line: “SMP SEO - [Your Nickname]"

2. In your cover letter, mention which of our core values resonates with you the most.

3. Include a link to your resume.

4. Use at least 7 Apply Points to qualify for this job.

5. Please DO NOT
 me. Let's keep all communication within OLJ.

title: Growth and Marketing Director (CMO)
description:
We are a fast-growing creator management agency. Today we do around $300,000 per month in gross sales across a roster of 29 creators. Over the next 12 months we are scaling toward $1,000,000+ per month and a roster of 80+ creators.

The single biggest lever on that growth is traffic, getting far more eyes on our creators' content across social media. Our distribution runs across mainstream platforms: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X,
, Threads and Reddit, in both short-form and long-form video. This role owns that engine.



Title: Chief Marketing Officer

Reports to: COO

Manages: 5 direct reports (Short form distribution, editing, creative, client success, Youtube Director), who each run their own team

Function: Growth, multi-platform traffic and subscriber acquisition



Purpose

This person exists to own and multiply the agency's traffic and subscriber numbers across every platform, and to build a distribution engine that no longer depends on any single platform.



Strategic significance

Subscribers generated is the single biggest constraint on the business. Today no senior leader owns it, so it defaults to a founder, which caps growth and keeps a founder stuck in execution. With this seat filled, the constraint gets a dedicated owner, the multi-platform engine gets built and driven, and the founders move up to strategy. Without it, the agency stays dependent on one platform and on a founder's bandwidth.



Responsibilities

This role owns the entire path from a piece of content to a paying subscriber, across every

platform, and runs it like a weekly project with clear deliverables and owners.

1. Own the growth number 

*Accountable end to end for subscribers, views and traffic across every platform.

2. Build and drive multi-platform distribution 

*Stand up and scale presence across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X,
, Threads and Reddit, in short-form and long-form video, with every creator live and posting, and are purposing system that multiplies one asset into many compliant placements.

3. Own the content-to-subscriber path

*Design and protect the path from social to subscriber, and recover conversion as platform rules change.

4. Run creative, distribution and editing as one engine

*Make the creative, distribution and editing functions work as a single growth machine, and elevate the output of the creative team.

5. Own platform compliance for growth

*Keep accounts alive and growing through platform crackdowns, with compliance checks built into posting before content goes wide.

6. Own per-platfor
asurement

*Stand up the data that shows what is posted, how it performs and how it converts on every platform, and act on it weekly.



Non-negotiables

? Self-starter, owns outcomes without being chased

? Operates through a team, builds systems rather than doing everything personally

? Carries a number publicly and is comfortable being measured on it

? Builds the playbook, does not wait to be handed one



Results

Measured on the growth engine. Targets set quarterly in planning.

1. Subscribers generated (all platforms)

*The primary KPI. New subscribers per month across every channel.

2. Platform coverage

*Percentage of the roster live and posting across the target platforms. The leading indicator that moves before subscribers do.

3. Total views and reach

*The volume that feeds subscribers.

4. Conversion

*How efficiently audience becomes subscribers.

5. Compliance and violation rate

*Accounts stay alive and violations stay low while distribution goes wide.

Targets and weightings set quarterly with the COO.



Scale milestone (12 months)

A diversified multi-platform engine that no longer depends on any single platform, fully owned by this seat, with the founders out of the day-to-day creative system



Requirements

Experience (non-negotiable)

title: Accounting Associate
description:
Own the numbers. Shape the process. Be the backbone of a growing global business. We’re looking for a detail-driven Accounting Manager who enjoys owning the books—not just maintaining them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in inventory-based accounting, understands how numbers flow across e-commerce channels, and wants to play a key role in keeping a fast-moving business financially clean, accurate, and compliant. You’ll work with real volume, real inventory, and real impact—helping ensure our balance sheet tells the true story of the business at all times.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:

-Own the balance sheet and ensure it is accurate, fully reconciled, and audit-ready

-Manage inventory accounting, resolve variances, and keep quantities and values aligned

-Calculate and reconcile Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) across multiple sales channels

-Ensure proper revenue recognition across marketplaces and platforms

-Prepare journal entries and support smooth month-end and quarter-end closes

-Keep books current throughout the month—not just at close

-Maintain strong GAAP compliance and clean, well-documented financial records



What We’re Looking For

-Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

-3–5+ years of accounting experience (inventory or e-commerce experience is a strong plus)

-Strong expertise in balance sheet and inventory accounting

-Experience with revenue recognition across multiple sales platforms

-High proficiency in QuickBooks Online

-Advanced skills in Excel / Google Sheets

-Highly organized, dependable, and able to work independently with minimal supervision



Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

title: E-commerce Assistant Store Manager
description:
We operate three profitable E-commerce stores and are currently launching our fourth. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a highly experienced E-commerce Assistant Store Manager to handle day-to-day operations, support customers across multiple channels, and help keep our systems running smoothly.



This is a senior-level role with long-term potential for the right candidate. Please read the full job description and answer all questions for your application to be considered.



IMPORTANT: Please read the entire job description and follow the application instructions carefully to be considered.



Responsibilities

• Manage customer inquiries via phone,
, and chat with professionalism and accuracy.

• Handle RFQs, returns/exchanges, complaints, disputes, and negative reviews.

• Collect and maintain positive customer reviews and overall satisfaction.

• Support sales-related tasks and assist in improving store performance.

• Collaborate with the CS, Orders, and Product teams to share insights and ensure a consistent customer experience.

• Identify process gaps, recommend improvements, and contribute to SOP updates.

• Perform daily administrative tasks, including EOS reports and operational updates.

• Proactively manage assigned tasks without waiting for instructions.



What You Need to Succeed -



Required Experience:

• 2+ years in E-commerce operations (customer service + order management + product management).

• Proven Shopify experience (listings, inventory, bulk updates, app usage).

• Strong phone communication skills and ability to handle challenging conversations calmly.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong attention to detail (include the word mushroom in your application).



Technical Requirements:

• Proficiency in Shopify, ClickUp, Airtable, CRM tools, and Google Workspace.

• Reliable computer + 20 Mbps+ internet.

• Backup solutions for both power and internet outages.



Work Style:

• Self-directed - you take initiative and solve problems independently.

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy.

• Customer-focused - complaints are opportunities to improve systems.

• Process-minded - you document and refine workflows naturally.



Work Schedule:

• Full-time, 40 hours/week

• US business hours: 9 PM–6 AM or 10 PM–7 AM PHT

• 1-hour break

• Five days per week



You're NOT a Fit If:

• You need micromanagement or detailed daily task lists

• You can't work 9 PM–7 AM PHT consistently

• You experience frequent power/internet outages without backup solutions

• You view this as temporary income between other opportunities



Before You Apply - Please Confirm:

• Weekly payments for the first 4 weeks (starting from week 3), then bi-monthly every other Tuesday.

• Full-time role, US hours.

• Must be open to a two-month trial period.

• Daily End of Shift (EOS) report answering:

a) What did you do today? (detailed description)

b) What issues did you run into?

c) Anything you need help with?

If you agree to all terms, write “I AGREE TO ALL TERMS” and answer the questions below.



Application Instructions (Follow Exactly) -



Subject Line:

[Your First Name] – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager

Example: Kevin – I Am Your New E-commerce Assistant Store Manager



Submit:

• Cover letter (focused on relevant e-commerce experience)

• Resume



Answer These Questions (Complete Sentences Required):

1. Describe your most relevant e-commerce operations experience (platforms used, team size, order volume, responsibilities).

2. What specific Shopify tasks have you performed?

3. What are your current work commitments and availability?

4. Provide your internet speed (include screenshot), computer specifications, and backup solutions for power & internet issues.

5. Provide one example of a difficult customer situation you handled and how you resolved it.

6. Why are you interested in this specific role instead of other VA positions?



Important: AI-generated or template responses will be immediately disqualified. We're looking for thoughtful, specific answers that demonstrate you read and understood this posting.

title: Agentic B2B Outreach Builder & Operator (AI + HubSpot)
description:
We’re hiring an Agentic B2B Outreach Builder & Operator to build and own an AI-led outbound engine for a company selling premium hyperbaric wellness equipment to clinics, wellness centers, recovery facilities, sports and performance businesses, and luxury hospitality groups.



This starts as a flexible 20-hour-per-week part-time role and can grow into full-time work for someone who demonstrates exceptional ownership, accountability, AI capability, and measurable outreach results.



THE OUTCOME



You will own the complete outreach cycle:



• Define and refine ideal customer profiles, target accounts, and decision-maker personas

• Research and enrich prospects using modern data and AI tools

• Build personalized LinkedIn and
 outreach workflows

• Use AI agents to classify replies, draft or send responses within clear guardrails, ask qualification questions, handle routine objections, and book qualified calls

• Keep HubSpot clean and complete as the centralized CRM and system of record

• Log outreach, replies, qualification state, meetings, opt-outs, and next actions in HubSpot

• Monitor deliverability, LinkedIn account safety, workflow failures, and data quality

• Test messaging, targeting, sequences, and agent behavior to improve results

• Report weekly on outreach volume, positive replies, qualified opportunities, meetings, pipeline, and experiments



STACK



HubSpot is mandatory. Everything else is outcome-based.



You may use n8n, Make, Clay, HeyReach, AI models, coding agents, enrichment tools, or better alternatives. We care less about specific logos and more about whether you can design a reliable, auditable system and clearly explain your choices.



AUTOMATION STANDARDS



We want agentic automation, not reckless automation.



The initial system should use human review while messages and reply logic are validated. Low-risk, proven conversation categories may become more autonomous over time. The system must include clear escalation rules, immediate opt-out handling, auditability, failure alerts, and account-safety controls.



Because this is a wellness-related product, outreach must avoid unsupported medical claims. LinkedIn and
 workflows must respect applicable platform rules, deliverability standards, and consent or opt-out requirements.



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VA ROLE



This is not manual lead-list building, copy-pasting messages, or simply operating someone else’s sequence. You must actively use AI to research, architect, build, debug, evaluate, document, and continuously improve the outreach system.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Proven experience building and operating B2B outbound systems

• Strong HubSpot experience, including workflows, lifecycle stages, properties, deduplication, and reporting

• Hands-on experience with AI agents, LLM workflows, automation platforms, APIs, webhooks, and JSON

• Experience with LinkedIn and
 outreach, personalization, qualification, and deliverability

• Ability to troubleshoot complex workflows and proactively improve weak systems

• Excellent written English and clear documentation

• High ownership, reliability, and accountability



Experience with high-ticket products, wellness, medical devices, clinics, hospitality, or performance and recovery businesses is a strong advantage.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word AGENTIC.



Include all of the following:



1. A 3–5 minute Loom showing a real AI automation or outreach system you built. Redact sensitive client information.

2. A short proposal for the HubSpot-centered architecture you would use for this role, including your preferred tools and why.

3. An example of how your system would handle four reply types: interested, objection, unsubscribe, and unclear.

4. The AI tools you use daily and how you validate agent output before trusting it.

5. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, timezone, and earliest possible start date.



Generic applications without evidence of real work will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates should expect a $100 paid practical exercise taking approximately 2–3 hours before final selection.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



Compensation is US$10–$20 per hour based on proven experience. We can pay up to US$25 per hour for an exceptional candidate with strong AI, HubSpot, and B2B outreach evidence.



The role begins at approximately 20 flexible hours per week and may grow into a full-time position based on performance and mutual fit.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Customer Support Specialist

 and social media communication. This is a 

part-time, long-term role for someone who wants stability and the

THE ROLE

You'll be the first point of contact for our customers over
 and 

social media. Your job is to keep both channels clean and answered: read 

what comes in, respond politely and accurately, and make sure nothing sits 

unanswered.



Our customers are Norwegian, so every reply you send, by
 and on 

social media, must be written in Norwegian. You do NOT need to speak 

Norwegian yourself. You'll work from a structured library of pre-approved 

Norwegian response templates that I'll provide and train you on, together 

with AI translation tools. The volume is manageable and most messages are 

recurring, so the templates will cover the large majority of what comes in.



What I value most is precise written English, strong attention to detail, 

and a calm, friendly tone.



YOUR DAILY TASKS

- Check and clear the support inbox three times per day: morning, midday, 

  and evening. All replies go out in Norwegian.

- Respond to comments on our
 pages three times per day, on the 

  same schedule, in Norwegian

- Maintain our tracking sheets daily so every message and its status is 

  logged

- Write short daily notes at the end of your day: what you handled, what 

  needs my attention, and anything unusual you noticed

- Escalate anything sensitive or unclear to me instead of guessing



TOOLS YOU'LL WORK WITH

- Claude (AI assistant) for drafting responses and for translating to and 

  from Norwegian

- DeepL as a second check whenever you're unsure about a translation. If 

  the two don't agree, or something still feels off, ask me. Never send a 

  translation you're not confident in.

- Google Sheets for daily logging

- Our helpdesk platform



You must already have hands-on experience with these tools, or be genuinely 

familiar with them. This is not a role where you'll be learning them from 

scratch. In your application, tell me specifically how you've used AI tools 

and translation tools in your previous work.



REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 3 years of experience in a customer support role

- Experience handling customer service for a fashion dropshipping store

- Excellent written English; you write clearly, correctly, and professionally

- Proven track record supporting online stores (please name them, see below)

- Hands-on experience with AI assistants (Claude, or similar)

- Hands-on experience with DeepL or comparable translation tools

- Confident with Google Sheets

- Familiarity with a helpdesk platform (Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar)

- Highly organized and process-driven; you follow instructions carefully

- Proactive communicator; you ask questions instead of assuming

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

- Active WhatsApp account for daily communication



A PLUS

- Experience moderating social media comments

- Any experience working in a language you don't speak natively, using 

  templates and translation tools



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FRO

- A stable, long-term position with a consistent, light workload

- Clear processes, documented templates, and proper onboarding

- Direct, respectful communication and genuine appreciation for your work

- 13th month bonus

- Room to take on a broader role as the business grows



Hours: 2 to 3 hours per day, split across three short check-ins (morning, 

midday, evening). This is a light, part-time workload, not a full-time 

position. Flexible on exact timing as long as the three check-ins happen.



Compensation: $3 to $5 per hour, depending on your experience. Please 

include your expected hourly rate in your application.



HIRING PROCESS

Strong applicants will be contacted on WhatsApp, and from there we'll set 

up a relaxed 10-minute video call so we can get to know each other and 

confirm we're the right fit before moving forward. Day-to-day communication 

in this role also runs through WhatsApp, so an active account is required.



HOW TO APPLY

Attach your CV as a file to your application. Applications without an 

attached CV will not be reviewed.



In your message, please tell me:

1. How many years you've worked in customer support, and in what type of 

   companies

2. Your experience with fashion dropshipping stores specifically

3. The names of the online stores or brands you've supported, with website 

   links if you have them. I want to see the kind of businesses you've 

   worked with.

4. The AI tools, translation tools, and helpdesk platforms you've worked with

5. Why you'd be a strong fit for this role



I review every application personally, so please keep yours clear and 

specific. Applications without concrete store names will not be considered. 

To confirm you've read the full post, begin your message with the word 

TITANKJOKKEN at the very top, before anything else. Applications without 

it will not be reviewed.

title: Credit Repair & Business Funding Specialist (Contractor)
description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Credit Repair & Business Funding Specialist to support our growing client base. This is a contractor role for someone who can manage credit-improvement workflows and help clients prepare for legitimate business-funding opportunities.



What You’ll Do



- Review consumer credit reports and identify inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable information.

- Assist clients with credit-profile cleanup, including properly addressing hard inquiries and account-status issues where permitted and supported by documentation.

- Help clients understand credit-building steps, utilization, payment history, and account management.

- Assess business and personal credit readiness for financing.

- Support business-funding preparation, lender packaging, document collection, and funding strategy.

- Maintain accurate client records, timelines, updates, and confidentiality.



Required Qualifications



- 5+ years of hands-on experience in credit repair, credit restoration, business credit, and/or business funding.

- Proven knowledge of FCRA, FDCPA, CROA, and applicable credit-repair compliance requirements.

- Experience reading and analyzing reports from Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.

- Experience with compliant dispute processes, inquiry challenges, account-status issues, and client communication.

- Knowledge of business funding products, lender requirements, underwriting readiness, and funding documentation.

- Strong written communication, organization, discretion, and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and provide timely progress updates.



Preferred



- Experience using credit repair CRM or dispute-management platforms.

- Experience with business credit profile building and lender relations.

- Relevant certifications or a demonstrated portfolio of compliant work.

- Experience in disputing profiles (close, inquiries, collections, etc.) 



Important Compliance Note



We are seeking a professional who follows all applicable laws and ethical standards. Work must be limited to accurate, properly documented, and legally supportable disputes and credit-improvement services. No false claims, deceptive practices, or guaranteed outcomes.



To Apply



Please send:



- A brief summary of your relevant experience

- Your experience with credit repair and business funding

- The tools/platforms you use

- Your hourly or project-based rate

- Your availability and earliest possible start date



We are looking to hire promptly.

title: Instagram Account Manager - iPHONE ONLY, No Client Accounts on Your Phone (Long-Term)
description:
READ THIS FIRST - THREE HARD REQUIREMENTS



If you do not meet all three, please do not apply. I will only have to say no, and we both lose time.



1) iPHONE ONLY.

You must manage the account from an iPhone. No Android, no exceptions. Tell me the exact model.



2) NO OTHER INSTAGRAM ACCOUNTS MANAGED ON THAT IPHONE.

Your own personal Instagram is completely fine. But that phone must NOT be used to manage anyone else's Instagram accounts - no client accounts, no secondary or "burner" accounts, not now and not in the past.

Why this matters: Instagram links accounts together through the device. A phone that has hosted several managed accounts puts our account at risk from day one. This is the single most important requirement in this job post.

You will be asked to send a screenshot as proof: open Instagram, tap your profile picture (bottom right), tap your username at the top to open the account switcher, and screenshot that list.

Please be honest. A personal account will NOT disqualify you. Lying will end the job later, once the account is already damaged.



3) PAYMENT IN CRYPTO ONLY - USDC on the ERC-20 network (Ethereum chain).

No other coin, no other chain. No PayPal, no GCash, no Wise, no bank transfer. If you cannot receive USDC via ERC-20, this will not work.



THE ROLE



Long-term Instagram Account Manager for ONE single account. Simple, ongoing daily work - a great fit if you know Instagram well and can be consistent every day. A full handbook and step-by-step SOPs are provided, so you do not need experience with our exact system.



What you will do:

- Manage ONE Instagram account, always from the SAME iPhone and the SAME internet connection

- Daily warm-up: scroll, like, comment and follow accounts in our niche (3 short sessions per day) and screen-record it

- Post the content we prepare for you (photos, reels, stories) from a shared Google Drive folder, using the caption and time we give you

- Reply to every comment and DM using our approved reply scripts

- Upload a short daily proof of your work to Google Drive



Important: the first 1-2 weeks are WARM-UP ONLY. No posting at all - just interacting, roughly 45-60 minutes a day. That is how the account stays safe. If that sounds boring to you, this is not your role.



What we need from you:

- Good, natural written English

- You know Instagram well (Reels, Stories, trending audio, hashtags)

- Reliable and consistent - you can work every single day

- Able to follow clear steps and rules exactly. This is the whole job.

- Long-term commitment



HOURS AND PAY

Starts at around 45-60 minutes a day during the warm-up phase, then settles at roughly 1.5 to 2 hours per day, 6 days per week. Flexible timing.

$40/month to start, paid in USDC (ERC-20 / Ethereum). This is a starting rate for a small, simple workload - if you prove reliable, there is room to grow with us as the account grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Answer these four points, in this order:

1. Which exact iPhone model do you use?

2. How many Instagram accounts are logged in on that iPhone right now, and how many have been logged in on it in the past? Attach the account-switcher screenshot.

3. Can you receive USDC on the ERC-20 network (Ethereum)?

4. Your experience with Instagram, and why you would be reliable for a daily long-term role.



Applications that do not answer all four points will be ignored.

Identifying patterns and reporting issues that impact revenue

Maintaining accurate notes and documentation in all systems

Experience working with insurance companies and handling denials

Ability to read and interpret EOBs and payer responses

High attention to detail and accuracy

Ability to manage multiple providers and priorities at once

Submitting claims is the lowest level of this role. The value is in identifying problems, preventing denials, and getting claims paid.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR — AI VIDEO ADS (KLING / AI TOOLS + CAPCUT) — LONG-TERM ROLE, US ECOMMERCE BRAND
description:
We are a US-based ecommerce company hiring full-time video editors to produce short video ads (30–60 seconds) for
 and Instagram. This is a long-term, permanent full-time position — we are looking for people who want stable work with one company, not a short project. We are hiring MORE THAN ONE editor for this role.



THE JOB



You will receive a complete package for every ad: a finished script, a creative brief, and example videos showing the style to match. Your job is to turn that package into a finished video ad:



- Generate AI video clips using image-to-video tools (we use Kling via Higgsfield — we provide all accounts and all tools, you pay for nothing)

- Generate the starting images for those clips with AI image tools, using prompts you develop with our AI assistant

- Source real B-roll clips from TikTok, YouTube, and similar platforms where the shot calls for it

- Generate the voiceover with AI (ElevenLabs) from the provided script

- Assemble everything in the editing software you are most comfortable with (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, etc.): edit to the voiceover, add captions, add music, export

- Each ad is delivered as three versions with different openings (we will train you on our exact method — it is fast once learned)



You do not write scripts and you do not need marketing knowledge. We provide the script, the brief, and the reference videos. You provide clean, fast, good-looking execution. Work is assigned and tracked through a simple board — you always know exactly what to work on next.



REQUIREMENTS (all of these are hard requirements)



- Proven video editing experience — you must link a portfolio or showreel in your application. Ideally it includes short-form ads or social content. Applications without a linked portfolio will be rejected.

- Hands-on experience with at least one AI video or image generation tool (Kling, Runway, Pika, Midjourney, or similar) — tell us which ones and how you've used them

- Skilled in the editing software of your choice (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar) — tell us which one you use



A BIG PLUS (not required, but tell us if you have it)



- Experience using Claude (the AI assistant by Anthropic) or similar AI chat assistants — you will use Claude daily to break scripts into scenes and write generation prompts (we provide the prompts and will train you)

- Good written English — all communication is written and async

- Reliable internet connection AND backup power/internet for outages

- Individual applicants only — no agencies, no teams. The person who applies is the person who does the work.

- Available full-time (8 hours/day, Monday–Saturday)



PAY



$800–$1,400 USD/month depending on experience, fixed, paid reliably every month. Real opportunity for pay growth as your output proves itself — we are building a long-term creative team and this role grows with the company.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that skip any step will not be read.



1. Start your application with the word KINGFISHER on the first line of your message.

2. Link your portfolio or showreel (see requirements).

3. List the AI video/image tools you have personally used and one sentence on what you made with each. If you have used Claude or another AI assistant, say so and tell us what for.

4. Confirm you are available full-time, Monday to Saturday, and are applying as an individual.

5. Answer this short exercise. Imagine you are producing a video ad from a script we gave you. Four situations come up. For each one, tell us which ONE action you would take and give one sentence explaining why.



   a) One line of the script feels awkward to you and you think you could word it better. Do you: REWRITE IT / FLAG IT AND BUILD IT AS WRITTEN / SKIP THAT LINE?

   b) The example video we gave you for style reference features a well-known influencer talking to camera. Do you: CLIP HER FOOTAGE INTO OUR AD / RECREATE THE SAME STYLE OF SHOT WITH AN AI-GENERATED PERSON / ASK US TO LICENSE HER FOOTAGE?

   c) An AI-generated clip looks great except the person's hands are warped. Do you: SHIP IT, VIEWERS WON'T NOTICE / REGENERATE THE CLIP WITH A FIXED PROMPT / CROP THE HANDS OUT IF POSSIBLE, OTHERWISE REGENERATE?

   d) You need a generic clip of a dog running in a park and can't find good free footage. Do you: LEAVE THAT SHOT OUT / GENERATE IT WITH AI / USE A CLIP THAT ALMOST FITS?



Shortlisted candidates will have a short interview, and final candidates will complete a SHORT PAID test project (we pay you for it). We read every application that follows the instructions. We're hiring as soon as we find the right people.

title: Product Manager - SaaS
description:
gigCMO is a dynamic growth consultancy providing strategic marketing leadership and expertise to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs, propelling them toward profitable revenue growth. Nestled in the heart of the City of London, United Kingdom, we specialise in supporting B2B clients in expanding their reach domestically and internationally. Our dedicated team, operating under the banner of Magnacca International, is strategically based in the Philippines. We chose this location for its pool of talent, strong social skills, enthusiasm, and unwavering loyalty.



We are seeking a dedicated and dynamic Product Manager to lead and enhance our Digital Church Platform®. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the product development lifecycle, managing development resources effectively, and ensuring rigorous final testing processes before releasing software updates. You will also play a critical role in translating the strategic vision held by the founder into actionable roadmaps and product deliverables.



Key Responsibilities:



- Manage the Product Development (PD) pipeline, ensuring alignment with organisational goals.

- Prioritise and allocate development resources efficiently to align with strategic priorities.

- Conduct comprehensive final testing and quality assurance to guarantee smooth, error-free software updates before public release.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver product enhancements that meet user needs and drive platform adoption.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders regarding project timelines, milestones, and release schedules.

- Translate strategic vision and high-level ideas from leadership into actionable product roadmaps, user stories, and specifications. 

- Facilitate clear and consistent communication between non-technical stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring all parties are aligned.

- Set up and manage internal systems (e.g. Basecamp and HubSpot) to track backlog, sprints, and milestones.

- Gather feedback from churches and users to shape future features and improvements. 

- Monitor product performance or user feedback loops to inform decisions and prioritisation. 

- Monitor incoming requests via helpdesk and chat channels, triage issues, and ensure timely resolution either directly or by coordinating with the development team.



Qualifications:



- Proven experience in Product Management, ideally within digital platforms or SaaS environments.

- Strong organisational skills with an ability to manage multiple development priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in software testing and quality assurance.

- Demonstrable capability in managing software product lifecycles effectively.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to engage stakeholders at various levels.

- Previous experience in digital community platforms or faith-based digital services is advantageous but not essential.
